# matterbridge_select_devices (Data Source)

The devices that a plugin offers for its whiteList, blackList and deviceFeatureBlackList (the device list of the config editor).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "matterbridge_select_devices" "zigbee2mqtt" {
  plugin = "matterbridge-zigbee2mqtt"
}

# Fail the plan if a device in the white list does not exist in the plugin.
check "devices_exist" {
  assert {
    condition     = alltrue([for name in ["Office Ceiling"] : contains(data.matterbridge_select_devices.zigbee2mqtt.names, name)])
    error_message = "A device in the white list is not offered by matterbridge-zigbee2mqtt."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin` (String) The plugin, for example matterbridge-zigbee2mqtt.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `names` (List of String) The device names, for a contains() check.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `entities` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices--entities))
- `name` (String) The device name. The lists of the config use it.
- `registered` (Boolean) True if the device is registered in Matterbridge now (matterbridge_devices).
- `selected` (Boolean) True if the current whiteList and blackList let the plugin expose the device. An empty whiteList selects all devices.
- `serial_number` (String) The serial number.

<a id="nestedatt--devices--entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices.entities`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String) The feature, for example device_temperature. deviceFeatureBlackList uses it.
